title: Destination
description: A deployment target where signals can be activated (DSP, sales agent, etc.)

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is a platform-based deployment

account.description: Optional account identifier on the platform

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is an agent URL-based deployment

agent_url.description: URL identifying the deployment agent (for sales agents, etc.)

account.description: Optional account identifier on the agent

delivery_method.description: Optional operator pin for provider-initiated delivery to this agent destination. The signal agent MUST use a matching rail or fail this destination with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, never falling back. Agents that do not list signals.delivery_methods MUST reject a pin. Without a pin it chooses from the pattern+vendor intersection. Applies to activate_signal only; ignored on get_signals destinations, where it neither filters nor errors. Experimental (signals.delivery_methods).

pattern.description: Delivery pattern (see core/signal-delivery-method.json). tmp_identity_match is not one.

vendor.description: Rails vendor to require; omit to pin the pattern only.
